title: bloodhound /usage extractor
description: A ruleset for pulling numbers out of a captured /usage panel. One ships bundled with the binary; a learned one is written to $XDG_DATA_HOME/bloodhound/extractors.json when the panel's layout changes and the daemon heals itself against a live capture. Hand-editing is supported and is the fallback when a heal cannot run.

version.description: The extractor contract this file is written against. It must match the version the running binary expects; a file from an older contract is refused and the bundled default is used instead, which is what makes a stale learned extractor a degradation rather than a failure.

generated_by.description: "default" for the bundled ruleset, "claude" for one a self-heal learned.

fields.description: One rule per value read out of the panel. A rule marked required and matching nothing fails the whole extraction, which is the signal that drives a self-heal.

name.description: The field this rule fills. The names the rest of bloodhound reads are session_pct, session_reset, session_reset_tz, week_pct, week_reset, week_reset_tz and their opus counterparts.

type.description: How the captured group is parsed.

regex.description: Go regexp applied to the whole captured panel. It must compile, or the whole ruleset is refused.

group.description: Which capture group carries the value. 0 is the whole match.

required.description: Whether a miss fails the extraction. The percentages and reset times are required; anything optional is a nicety the panel may or may not carry.
